items.informal_name: Sum of Natural Numbers from 0 to $ n-1 $
items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, i = n * (n - 1) / 2
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, the sum of all natural numbers from $ 0 $ to $ n-1 $ is equal to $ \frac{n(n-1)}{2} $, i.e., $ \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} i = \frac{n(n-1)}{2} $.

items.informal_name: Twice the Sum of 0 to $ n-1 $ Equals $ n(n-1) $
items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ), (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, i) * 2 = n * (n - 1)
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, twice the sum of all natural numbers from $ 0 $ to $ n-1 $ is equal to $ n(n-1) $, i.e., $ 2 \cdot \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} i = n(n - 1) $.

items.informal_name: Telescoping Sum Identity in Additive Commutative Groups
items.type: ∀ {G : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommGroup G] (f : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f (i + 1) - f i) = f n - f 0
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative group $G$, function $f : \mathbb{N} \to G$, and natural number $n$, the sum $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} (f(i+1) - f(i))$ equals $f(n) - f(0)$.

items.informal_name: Telescoping Sum Identity: $ \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} (f(i) - f(i+1)) = f(0) - f(n) $
items.type: ∀ {G : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommGroup G] (f : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f i - f (i + 1)) = f 0 - f n
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative group $ G $, function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to G $, and natural number $ n $, the sum of $ f(i) - f(i+1) $ over all $ i $ in the range $ 0 $ to $ n-1 $ is equal to $ f(0) - f(n) $.

items.informal_name: Sum over Range Minus Last Term Identity
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_4} (f : ℕ → M) {n : ℕ} [inst : AddCommGroup M],
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f i - f n = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative group $ M $, function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to M $, and natural number $ n $, the equation $ \sum_{i=0}^n f(i) - f(n) = \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} f(i) $ holds.

items.informal_name: Telescoping Sum Identity in Additive Commutative Groups
items.type:
∀ {G : Type u_7} [inst : AddCommGroup G] (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → G),
  (List.map (fun k => f (k + 1) - f k) (List.range n)).sum = f n - f 0
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative group $ G $, natural number $ n $, and function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to G $, the sum of the differences $ f(k+1) - f(k) $ for $ k = 0 $ to $ n-1 $ satisfies $ \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} \big(f(k+1) - f(k)\big) = f(n) - f(0) $.
